Dr John Thorndyke and his friend Dr Jervis are watching the procession of the Russian Grand Duke who is on a State Visit. However, a disturbance in the crowd diverts their attention and discovery of a letter in cipher starts a chain of events that nearly cost Dr Thorndyke his life. A Mr Barton insists on seeing Dr Thorndyke at his home saying he has come on a matter of life and death. He fears that his brother is being poisoned and he brings a sample of arrowroot from some his brother was having for breakfast that morning.
